d: Presenting the video song "Muqabla" from the bollywood movie StreetDancer3D, The movie features Varun Dhawan, Shraddha Kapoor, Nora Fatehi, and Prabhu Deva in lead roles and directed by Remo D'Souza, produced by Bhushan Kumar, Divya Khosla Kumar, Krishan Kumar & Lizelle D’Souza. Witness the king of dance, Prabhudeva back with Muqabla in the voice of Yash Narvekar, and Parampara Thakur, penned and composed by Tanishk Bagchi.
